ladder.label: NEARING A HIGH
ladder.why: Late in the daily cycle (day 32 of ~36-42) — odds favor a dip into the next cycle low from here even with the trend intact. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Let the next daily cycle low form before adding; watch for the swing-low setup.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum positive; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum positive; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 12 · daily cycle day 32).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a high. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds

entry.text: Stretched/late — protect gains and don't start new positions; let the next low set up first.

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 32 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: approaching the window where lows usually form
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 32 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.daily_phase_zh: 接近低点通常形成的时间窗口
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 12 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 12 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 处于日线周期晚期（约 36-42 天中的第 32 天）——即便趋势完好，从此处概率上仍倾向于回落至下一个周期低点。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 在加仓前先让下一个日线周期低点形成；留意摆动低点形态。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：混合 — 周线动量为正；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 12 周 · 日线周期第 32 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：接近高点。大局（趋势不明）：混合。
points_zh: 大局为混合（对日线多头而言属趋势不明）
宏观：美国净流动性中性——对概率属无方向性影响

ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ NEARING A HIGH signal just triggered today (fresh cross from BOTTOMING). Signal strength: mild (score -20/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 接近高点信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自筑底中翻转）。 信号强度：温和（评分 -20/100）。
ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: solid exit setting up (-40)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：稳健离场构筑中（-40）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
